description: System light/dark appearance and desktop preferences (accent color, reduce motion, high contrast, text scale) feed the default ui theme; apps can replace the theme with a copy or set the app’s appearance source.
events: system appearance changes rebuild the frame
accessibility_notes: Themes must keep contrast; HighContrast preference is designed for this.
platform_notes: Theme follows each OS appearance (macOS, Windows, Linux desktops); accent missing on Linux; text scale not on macOS; reduce-motion semantics differ (docs/native.md).

description: A status icon in the menu bar (macOS) or notification area (Windows/Linux) with a menu, title, tooltip, click/right-click handlers and dark-mode reporting.
key_methods: NewTray(TrayOptions{Icon, IconIsTemplate, Title, ToolTip, Menu, OnClick...})
accessibility_notes: Tray menus are native menus and get platform accessibility.
platform_notes: Linux needs AppIndicator (libayatana-appindicator); macOS menu bar; Windows notification area; template icons are macOS-only (docs/menus.md).

display_name: URL schemes, deep links & file associations (mygo.App.RegisterURLScheme, OnOpenURL, OnOpenFile)
description: Makes links like app://open/… launch the app and deliver the URL, and delivers files opened from the OS/Finder/Explorer; pairs with MyGo’s protocol handling and document support.
accessibility_notes: OS delivers the event; app should focus+announce the opened document.
platform_notes: Schemes registered per OS (macOS bundle URL types, Windows registry, Linux desktop entry) — set up by mygo build/config (docs/native.md).

description: Drives the OS window: visibility, focus, size/bounds/content size, minimize/maximize/full screen, opacity, shadow, always-on-top, taskbar/workspace, progress bar, flash, mouse passthrough, content protection.
accessibility_notes: Window chrome is the OS’s, so it follows each platform’s accessibility and appearance.
platform_notes: Some methods are platform-specific or no-ops elsewhere (SetActiveAppearance is macOS; progress bars macOS Dock/Windows taskbar/Linux launcher; SetSkipTaskbar Linux/Windows).

description: Creates a window: title, size/bounds, min/max, position, frameless, transparent, vibrancy, title-bar style, always-on-top, parent/panel, menus, state persistence, developer tools.
accessibility_notes: Window controls come from the OS; content inside is MyGo-drawn.
platform_notes: Title bar, traffic lights (macOS), GTK buttons on Linux, Windows 11 menu/acrylic differences; see docs/windows.md.

description: Restores window frame/maximized state between launches by key, backed by a file or the app’s own store.
accessibility_notes: No accessibility surface.
platform_notes: Implementation per OS uses the platform window APIs.

description: Shows the OS window material behind native UI where it draws no background: sidebar/under-window materials on macOS, Acrylic on Windows 11, and macOS 26 Liquid Glass for whole windows.
accessibility_notes: Content over the material keeps system antialiasing; over material text is grayscaled.
platform_notes: macOS + Windows 11 22H2+; Linux none (c.Vibrancy() false → draw a background). Before macOS 26 glass falls back to popover/HUD material.
